This plot is small and belongs to my household, so I will manage it mostly with family effort and keep costs low. Since I intercrop and grow tubers/root crops, I will use manure/compost if I can get it, but I will not spend much on chemical fertilizer. I will plant the seed I normally know and can trust, and I will depend on the rains instead of irrigation. I may use some chemical for weeds or pests if needed, but I do not expect to hire much outside labor.
